item: 4.10 — auto-mode server-fallback dialog: Continue / Stop card (2026-10-10)
branch: renderDialog (85-cards.js): a `dialog_request` frame of kind auto_mode_server_fallback draws a .card.warn.dlg — the payload's title as the header, each paragraph as a .dlg-p, the helpUrl linkified where a paragraph contains it or as a trailing 'Learn more' line (only https on claude.com / anthropic.com, the reference client's filter), the reference client's stock copy when title and paragraphs are both empty — with Continue (.ok) and Stop (.no) disabled for the first 500 ms (the CLI's armInputGrace), answering over the bridge as {kind:'dialog', result:'continue'|'interrupt'} and settling the footer; __perm_cancelled lapses it to Withdrawn. The first frame of each kind is kept in window.__dialogSeen (the 9.7 watch idiom).
provenance: The PAYLOAD shape and the result enum are the CLI's, read verbatim from the 2.1.296 binary's dialog definition: `Zo({kind:"auto_mode_server_fallback", payload: {gatewayHost: string optional, title: string, paragraphs: string[], helpUrl: string}, result: enum["continue","interrupt","cancelled"], default: "cancelled"})`; the host's answer schema is `{behavior: "completed"|"cancelled", result}`. The RENDER rules (title header, paragraphs, helpUrl accepted only when https on claude.com/anthropic.com or a subdomain, inline linkify vs a trailing Learn more, the stock sentence when both title and paragraphs are empty, Continue primary + Stop, both disabled 500 ms) are the VS Code webview's (2.1.296 index.js, the auto-mode-server-fallback-prompt component). The `dialog_request` frame itself and the `__perm_cancelled` frame are OURS (ChatPanel's translations of request_user_dialog / control_cancel_request) — self-consistency for the page half. The dialog has NEVER been observed on this wire (it needs the server classifier to be unavailable — not triggerable on demand); what IS measured: 2.1.296 accepts `initialize.supportedDialogKinds:["auto_mode_server_fallback"]` over stdio (success, 2026-10-10, bare initialize — no transcript written). __bridge is taped (sandbox-only run). NEGATIVE CONTROL: see the checklist row's evidence for the pre-change readings.
